Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A bartender and an optometrist each showed up early to drop their kids off at daycare today. It's easy to tell that the optometrist has a close relationship with their kid based on how they hugged each other goodbye, but the bartender just seemed to push the kid out the door, and the kid didn't seem surprised by this at all. Who is a caring parent?
A. Not known
B. The bartender
C. The optometrist
